name: Indelible
description: Indelible is a self-hosted read-it-later and knowledge library. It stores articles, newsletters, PDFs, and EPUBs in PostgreSQL and an S3-compatible object store, and the API serves the web app on the same port.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: S3 secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Auth credential key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Jwt secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Csrf secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Asset cookie secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Postgres password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  indelible:
    image: ghcr.io/useindelible/ind-api:0.1.1@sha256:04604c1bd64148b1bbb4edac8d4cc395b8332de97da6e9ffedeb60faffb526ab
    container_name: indelible
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      IND_ENV: development
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://indelible:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/indelible
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://silo:9000
      S3_REGION: us-east-1
      S3_BUCKET: indelible
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: indelible
      S3_SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_S3_SECRET_KEY}
      S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: "true"
      AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY: ${SECRET_AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY}
      EGRESS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS: "false"
      IND_HOST: 0.0.0.0
      IND_PORT: "8080"
      IND_BASE_URL: http://localhost:38473
      FRONTEND_URL: http://localhost:38473
      EXTENSION_REDIRECT_URIS: https://jidilhjojlgndbpeooeeceohmkedooef.chromiumapp.org/indelible,https://38bd18db5de5caccb6ab6c1271fec03ec1662d5c.extensions.allizom.org/indelible
      CORS_ORIGINS: http://localhost:38473
      JWT_SECRET: ${SECRET_JWT_SECRET}
      CSRF_SECRET: ${SECRET_CSRF_SECRET}
      ASSET_COOKIE_SECRET: ${SECRET_ASSET_COOKIE_SECRET}
      OIDC_ENABLED: "false"
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      silo:
        condition: service_healthy
      indelible-silo-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
  postgres:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg18@sha256:2358fcba361ed2233a5ed81b5fe4ca779ccb304120ce531a3bf51c0ed7e2bc11
    container_name: indelible-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: indelible
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: indelible
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U indelible -d indelible"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
  silo:
    image: docker.io/pgsty/silo:RELEASE.2026-08-06T00-00-00Z@sha256:29a498b24669cae1fed11c1a2fb2b3d73c68829a0a9c0b14e71b386671d38fac
    container_name: indelible-silo
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["server", "/data", "--console-address", ":9001"]
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: indelible
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_S3_SECRET_KEY}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/silodata:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "silo", "healthcheck", "ready"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
  indelible-silo-init:
    image: docker.io/pgsty/silo:RELEASE.2026-08-06T00-00-00Z@sha256:29a498b24669cae1fed11c1a2fb2b3d73c68829a0a9c0b14e71b386671d38fac
    container_name: indelible-silo-init
    restart: "no"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: indelible
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_S3_SECRET_KEY}
    depends_on:
      silo:
        condition: service_healthy
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        mcli alias set silo http://silo:9000 "$$MINIO_ROOT_USER" "$$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD" && mcli mb --ignore-existing silo/indelible
  renderer:
    image: ghcr.io/useindelible/ind-renderer:0.1.1@sha256:f43488ff9bc9c413b248a620ba9eed29e583699752305ed4cfbb63383e1af5cf
    container_name: indelible-renderer
    init: true
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      IND_ENV: development
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://indelible:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/indelible
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://silo:9000
      S3_REGION: us-east-1
      S3_BUCKET: indelible
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: indelible
      S3_SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_S3_SECRET_KEY}
      S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: "true"
      AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY: ${SECRET_AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY}
      EGRESS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS: "false"
      RENDERER_HOST: 0.0.0.0
      RENDERER_PORT: "3100"
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      silo:
        condition: service_healthy
  worker:
    image: ghcr.io/useindelible/ind-worker:0.1.1@sha256:4338ce6da40d7856fc8ad4eef567cfa8b5ec5b13f63a0a7e3bcd24efc394fa28
    container_name: indelible-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      IND_ENV: development
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://indelible:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/indelible
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://silo:9000
      S3_REGION: us-east-1
      S3_BUCKET: indelible
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: indelible
      S3_SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_S3_SECRET_KEY}
      S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: "true"
      AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY: ${SECRET_AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY}
      EGRESS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS: "false"
      RENDERER_URL: http://renderer:3100
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      silo:
        condition: service_healthy
      renderer:
        condition: service_started
      indelible-silo-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
notes: Open http://localhost:38473 and create the first account. Signups close after that account exists. This is the official localhost trial: plain HTTP, not the production compose. A public hostname needs HTTPS, and production mode refuses to boot without it. Replace JWT_SECRET, CSRF_SECRET, ASSET_COOKIE_SECRET, AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, and MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD before the first start. The catalog values are public. Keep the same Postgres password in DATABASE_URL, and keep S3_SECRET_KEY equal to MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD on silo and on indelible-silo-init. The initializer reads that environment value when it creates the bucket. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit those literals; they do not substitute Compose variables.
